name: Motlow State Community College
tuition_note: Full-time annual in-state (Tennessee resident) maintenance fees (tuition) & mandatory fees of $5,064 from official motlow.edu/financial/tuition-costs-fees page (in-state rate $197/credit hour up to 12 hours; figure shown for Fall 2026-Summer 2027 Cost of Attendance, same $197/hr rate as 2025-26). Motlow State is a commuter community college with multiple campuses and does NOT offer college-owned on-campus housing/dorms; the site lists only estimated 'Living Expenses (room and board)' budget figures, not billed housing charges, so housing_cost is null.
